wishes.name: Ayesha Karunaratne
wishes.message: Gayashan, you have always carried a quiet strength. Vishmi, you walked in and made that strength feel like warmth. May your home be patient, your table full, and your days kind to one another.

wishes.name: Dinuka Abeysekera
wishes.message: Vishmi, it is a joy to see this life begin with Gayashan. I bless the gentleness between you. Go forward as partners, and know your friends stand with you.

wishes.name: Menaka Rathnayake
wishes.message: I have watched this friendship become a promise. May you keep the laughter you already have, and find even more of it in the ordinary mornings ahead.
